information: # West Coast Cubing welcomes you to Las Vegas for Western Championship 2025! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU4NzksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--0ca43cca8d2fb3caa9578fb8c494c9ed9e1e7a9f/1000018351.png) ### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#58976-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Western Champs 2025!** The highest placing resident of California, Nevada, or Hawaii in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Western Champion! Check out the Western Championship Eligibility tab for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#43185-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#43187-sponsors-and-partners).
